description: While a reprocess runs, the client asks the Pending check (GET /v2/tracks/pending) about the rows it holds Pending (pending) and the edits it saved (awaiting). One the list shows (listed) that is no longer Pending means reading the list again (moved); one the list doesn't show has finished by the check alone (finished), since no list will say so. Expected: watched (the ids asked about, once each, pending first), moved, and finished, given the check's answer stillPending.

cases.name: an edit saved here is watched too, once
an edit that landed before the list saw it Pending
a Pending row the list doesn't show finishes by the check alone
an edit saved with its track out of view lands by the check
an edit out of view still Pending keeps waiting
a shown row and an unseen edit finish together
